total_supply_at_construction.meaning: totalSupply value pre-set by the HypoVault constructor (1 000 000) while the vault owns zero underlying assets

total_assets_before_first_fulfillment.meaning: totalAssets (computeNAV() == assetsDeposited) observed before the first fulfilment, equal to 1

zero_supply.meaning: the zero totalSupply the vault should start with per the intent

zero_assets.meaning: the zero underlying assets condition under which no shares should be minted per the intent

unbounded_loss_occurred.meaning: financial loss is unbounded (report-stated impact outcome)

assumptions: The vault's totalSupply and totalAssets are observable integer quantities at the stated checkpoints.
The intent's 'start with zero supply' is represented as the expected totalSupply value at vault start.

unresolved.description: The intent states shares should be minted only when assets exist, but the report does not give a mint-amount relation or the exact share-mint formula operands, so the minting condition cannot be fully encoded beyond the zero-supply/zero-assets correspondence.
Report does not specify the checkpoint at which totalAssets == 1 is observed relative to the constructor versus the first fulfillment.

limitations: The impact 'Financial loss is unbounded' is encoded as a grounded Boolean because the report provides no specific magnitude or affected-object observable.
The correspondence pattern captures the zero-supply-until-assets intent; the unbounded-loss impact is a separate V witness and its link to the intent violation is left to the post-generation audit.
